body:
Repeated row churn retained obsolete leaf packs, immutable manifest revisions and successful native appender creation history, while deletion retries could outlive manager shutdown. This repairs those ownership paths through the existing resource manager, recovery roots and GC, and supplies the supported lifecycle harness for #5060.

Implements #5066 under #5056, on merged #5065. Retained lifecycle qualification and public evidence remain #5060/#5061 gates.

- Cancel and join admitted deletion retries before manager files close; concurrent Close shares completion/error.
- Protect current, both selectable fallback roots, prepared publication and held readers while reclaiming obsolete immutable revisions through exact parent/file namespace leases and durable quarantine. Keep at most 16 selected deletion handles plus one scan child or quarantine placeholder and one temporary link-validation handle (18 GC child descriptors); revalidate the full inventory and fresh protection before every batch. Initial names/digests schedule work without supplying deletion authority.
- Keep the exact quarantine placeholder open until deletion returns. Validate its link before cleanup and before rename can overwrite its destination. Failed cleanup joins the original and cleanup causes, preserves canonical/rebound evidence and poisons further maintenance with ErrRecoveryRequired; successful cleanup preserves the original error and permits retry.
- Select each rebuilt current leaf pack's exact physical closure. Older protected roots keep their complete closure; released packs and length indexes become reclaimable.
- Retire successful native pointer registration bookkeeping only for the exact manager-owned file. Failed, ambiguous, unrelated and standalone rewrite records stay protected.
- Qualify the supported command-WAL fixture's effective/persisted options, full-root census and ordered maintenance boundaries. Capability guards refuse unsupported promotion fixtures before construction.

Revision GC completes eligible batches in one explicit call and preserves completed deletion counts after later failure. Writer and snapshot-admission locks span that call. Repeated full scans cost O(N²/16); per-phase footprint admission is not a cumulative I/O or pause quota. The guide and lifecycle specification describe these limits and distinguish merged #5065 integration from pending qualification.

No on-disk format, posting layout, production rotation cap, WAL mode or automatic maintenance policy changes. Persistent value/leaf logs remain storage; redo WAL is separate. External rewrite owner #5037 keeps its scope.

Validation on Linux185/111 with Go1.26.4, GOWORK=off and isolated matching caches:

- Final cleanup source52bc2147: focused revision normal 12.986s/race 14.609s/vet pass with actual argv, exits, toolchain and clean source before/after. Eight cases cover both pre-rename/rename errors, actual permission-denied cleanup, foreign files/directories, successful-hook destination rebound, retained causes/evidence and poisoned or lawful retries. All run without skips.
- Isolated RLIMIT_NOFILE64 with 257 revisions reproduces old EMFILE; fixed GC deletes 255/protects 2 in one call and reclaims the released held revision next call. The final focused suite also covers this regression. Rename-sampled descriptors reach 28; static additional GC child demand is 18, not a measured global peak.
- Bounded-GC broader normal 40.007s/race 44.808s/vet cover namespace rebind, current/held/prepared/both recovery roots, malformed inventory, dry/read-only/unsupported stores and sync failure. Partial cancellation preserves 17 completed deletions; malformed later scans preserve 16. Between-batch held protection prevents premature reclamation.
- Existing integration normal 43.445s/race 266.115s/vet, exact pack/current/fallback oracles, native creation history 18→0 RED/GREEN, two-process rehearsal and 83 packet/environment guards remain under their original source identities. The broad collections timeout and isolated passing vector test are both retained.
- Canonical CI refresh/check preserves14 workflows/56 members; all 58 Python contract tests pass. Currentmain's test/docs/script integration preserves the exact tested cleanup, relevant DB runtime/test and R1 docs blobs. Current-head hosted review and required CI still gate landing.

The public32-revision one-operation smoke is correctness/cost smoke only. Final D will measure repeated maintenance, physical component growth and sampled memory. Logical file census is not allocated blocks; sampled heap is not RSS or an exact peak. Finite active/latest-per-lane retention and bounded descriptor demand do not establish unlimited capacity or latency bounds.

Original deterministic failures, unsupported-platform failures, paired benchmark failures and timing-variance packets remain preserved. Exact852's one bounded unchanged-gate dispatch passed while its original variance failure remains failed; neither result qualifies this successor head. No threshold, sample or outlier rule changed.

Refs #5066, #5060; parent #5056. Does not close retained lifecycle, final evidence or parent gates.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * `LeafGenerationGC` now reclaims eligible immutable manifest revisions and reports revision counts and reclaimed bytes. Dry runs and unsupported compatibility stores leave revision files unchanged.
  * Storage compaction now selects packed resources based on current data while preserving resources needed by recoverable data.
  * Manager shutdown coordinates with background value-log deletion retries and waits for admitted work to finish.

* **Documentation**
  * Updated lifecycle, storage, and recovery guidance, including maintenance stages and the v3 benchmark format.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->


Current3182 auxiliary M0 timing remains FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; the matched main control also fails the unchanged noise rule. The [coordinator disposition and retained evidence](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/pull/5071#issuecomment-6015235219) explain why this auxiliary signal is nonblocking. This does not accept performance or capacity; exact required TreeDB/code checks and subsequent landed-source A/C/D qualification remain required.
title: Bound TreeDB churn resource ownership and qualify supported lifecycle tooling
